title: Acoustic session — 3 songs, one take (long-form)
hook: Three songs off the record, just me and the guitar.
body:
Sat down and played three off We're All Here the way they got written — one guitar, one take, no click. If you've only heard the studio versions, this is the other half of the story.

Chapters below. Full record's linked in the description.

script.visual: Start mid-song, 10 seconds of the best chorus, then title card
script.line: Open on the strongest chorus of the three

script.visual: Single warm setup, maybe two angles cut together
script.line: Play three songs, short honest sentence between each about where it came from

script.visual: Set the guitar down, thank them
script.line: Thanks for listening — full record's in the description.

shot_list: One warm room, guitar + vocal, ideally a second angle for cutaways
Record clean audio if you can (even a single mic beats phone audio for long-form)
Three songs; note which between-song stories are true before filming
cta: Full record's linked in the description — hit subscribe for more sessions.
media_notes: Evergreen long-form — feeds YouTube search + Spotify discovery. Slice 4–6 Shorts out of it afterward.
